task.prompt:
A small block starts at the beginning of segment 1 with speed 9 m/s and slides along a track made of 19 consecutive straight segments (in the direction of motion):
1. downhill incline at 26° to the horizontal, length 9.0 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.17
2. horizontal, length 8.8 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.30
3. uphill incline at 31° to the horizontal, length 5.3 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.07
4. downhill incline at 28° to the horizontal, length 2.3 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.21
5. downhill incline at 25° to the horizontal, length 4.9 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.24
6. uphill incline at 15° to the horizontal, length 3.5 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.16
7. downhill incline at 34° to the horizontal, length 2.4 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.37
8. downhill incline at 21° to the horizontal, length 11.4 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.21
9. horizontal, length 2.7 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.25
10. horizontal, length 4.4 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.13
11. downhill incline at 28° to the horizontal, length 10.0 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.10
12. uphill incline at 28° to the horizontal, length 7.8 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.12
13. downhill incline at 29° to the horizontal, length 7.1 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.20
14. horizontal, length 7.9 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.31
15. horizontal, length 1.0 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.34
16. downhill incline at 12° to the horizontal, length 7.9 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.10
17. downhill incline at 32° to the horizontal, length 8.9 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.23
18. downhill incline at 12° to the horizontal, length 9.5 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.32
19. downhill incline at 6° to the horizontal, length 7.6 m (measured along the surface), kinetic friction coefficient μ = 0.12

"Uphill" means the block moves up the incline, "downhill" means it moves down. The block stays in contact with the surface, passes every junction without any loss of speed, and there is no air resistance. Use g = 9.8 m/s². It is guaranteed that the block never stops on the track.

Find the speed of the block at the end of the last segment, in m/s, with 4 significant figures.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
